notes.title: Bugfix
notes.content:
Fixed a few achievements not being triggered.
Changed win-loss ratios.

notes.title: Release 1.1.0.56
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Now supporting hardware graphics.
[*] Added two new slots: Wild Star and Wild Bonus.
[*] Removed money-timer. You will now receive 250 credits every time you run out of cash. No more waiting!
[*] Various other fixes and improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.1.50
notes.content:
- Added more leaderboards.
- Timer will now countdown when not playing.
- Fixed start-button behaviour during PowerSpins.
- Windows Volume mixer now linked to app.
- Removed 'spins'. Now for a spin, 1 credit + (stake - 1) games are needed. At lowest stake, a credit will be moved to games when needed.
- Removed thirdparty soundlib, now using DirectSound directly.
- Reduced CPU usage (not by much since it was already very low).

notes.title: Added another slot: Jingle-Bells.
notes.content:
As the title says, we added another slot with a christmas-look:

Jingle-Bells
- 5 reels, 15 winlines, Santa is wild.
